outcome.reasoning:
Nitpicks: The agent’s formatting/wording choices (e.g., calling it “this step’s outcome” or providing a chronological reply list) are minor and do not affect usefulness. Also, selecting fewer than 8 could be fine if only one request/thread were visible or accessible.

Critical issues: The agent did not complete the core multi-item deliverable. The task requires inspecting up to 8 most recent substantive requests and (crucially) their visible thread replies, then producing per-request summaries. DOM evidence shows at least three substantive requests visible in-channel (Ding, tech, George n), and reply-count controls are visible for tech and George n, yet the agent only opened/inspected one thread (Ding’s). There is no environment blocker shown preventing opening additional threads or inspecting additional recent requests. Because the primary deliverable is a per-request report across up to 8 recent requests (not just one), the user would not consider the task completed.

What the agent did accomplish: For Ding’s request specifically, the agent’s extracted details (problem, latest visible reply “Please check now,” and status “unclear” with evidence that no explicit confirmation is visible) are supported by the latest DOM state showing the thread content. However, this is only a partial fulfillment because the required multi-request coverage and follow-up triage across multiple requests were not performed.
outcome.primary_intent: The user wanted a read-only triage-style summary of up to the 8 most recent substantive support requests in Slack channel #daytona-support, including what’s visible in each request’s thread replies, and for each: requester, timestamp, concise problem, latest response, and an evidence-backed status (explicitly resolved / explicitly unresolved / unclear) without inferring resolution. The user would be flexible on covering fewer than 8 only if fewer were visible/accessible or there was a stated access/visibility blocker, but not flexible on omitting multiple visible recent requests/threads when they are accessible.
